app_name: TaskPulse Work Oversight & Team Operations Hub

theme.description: High-contrast tactical operations hub with charcoal-obsidian depths, crisp 1px borders, and signal accents (amber for warning/due soon, crimson for critical/overdue, emerald for completed, and vibrant electric indigo/cobalt for primary actions). Cardless & dense layout with high scannability.

rules.overlines: font-mono uppercase text-xs tracking-[0.18em] text-slate-400 font-semibold
rules.metrics: font-heading font-extrabold tracking-tight text-2xl lg:text-3xl text-white

entry_surfaces./: split hero overview dashboard — top executive stat bar, priority triage panel & workload charts middle, live activity feed & quick action controls bottom
entry_surfaces./login: branded split auth view — left dark operations panel with live team oversight preview & demo role switchers (Manager vs Member), right clean credentials form

navigation_and_layout.shell_pattern: Left collapsible sidebar + sticky glass header with search, active role badge (Manager / Team Member), quick task creation button, role toggle, notification bell with badge counter + profile dropdown
header_features: Role Switcher pill (Manager / Team Member Alex / Team Member Maya / Team Member Carlos)
Global Search input for instant task or member filtering
Priority Alert summary trigger (Overdue count + Urgent tasks count)
Notification Bell with animated unread badge + rich popover list with 'Mark all as read' & direct click-to-task action
Primary Action: '+ Assign Task' (Manager only) or '+ Log Progress' (Member)

priority_triage_panel.title: Immediate Priority Action Center
priority_triage_panel.description: Surfaces Overdue, Due Soon (<24h), and Critical priority tasks requiring immediate attention
item_features: Due Date countdown with relative color coding (e.g., '2 days ago' in red, 'in 4h' in amber)

charts.name: Team Workload & Completion
charts.description: Stacked or grouped bars showing Tasks Assigned vs Tasks Completed vs Overdue per team member

charts.name: Status Distribution
charts.description: To Do (slate), In Progress (blue), In Review (purple), Done (emerald)

card_capabilities: Priority badge with colored dot (Critical, High, Medium, Low)
Interactive Progress Slider or quick percentage step buttons (0%, 25%, 50%, 75%, 100%)
Assignee chip with avatar and workload badge
Due date badge with alert indicators (Overdue = red pulse)
Latest progress note snippet and update count
Quick action menu: Change Status, Assign, Edit, Delete, Log Note

features: Full task metadata (Title, Description, Priority, Due Date, Created Date, Manager, Assignee)
Interactive Progress Slider with live percentage readout (0-100%)
Status selector with visual confirmation badge
Progress Update Notes Timeline: chronological feed of comments, updates, blockers, and % bumps with timestamp & author
Add Note Form: text area + optional tag ('Milestone', 'Blocker', 'Progress Note', 'Review Request') + submit button
Notification trigger: Manager is automatically alerted when a member updates progress or flags a blocker

member_cards: Overdue task count with badge alert
Direct action: 'Assign New Task', 'View Member Board', 'Send Nudge Alert'
List of currently assigned tasks with inline progress sliders

transitions.card_hover: transition-transform duration-200 ease-out hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-lg hover:border-slate-600

motion_and_interactions.reduced_motion: Wrap custom motion components in prefers-reduced-motion queries or use standard Tailwind CSS transitions.

accessibility_requirements.wcag_compliance: WCAG AA (4.5:1 minimum contrast on all text surfaces)
accessibility_requirements.aria_labels: All icon-only buttons (notification bell, search clear, filter reset, quick action menus) must have descriptive aria-label attributes
accessibility_requirements.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements, buttons, tabs, modal triggers, inputs, and priority alerts MUST include data-testid (e.g. data-testid='create-task-button', data-testid='priority-alert-overdue-chip', data-testid='task-progress-slider-123')

instructions_to_main_agent: Template is farm-ts (FastAPI backend + Vite/React 19 frontend with Tailwind v4). CSS entry is frontend/src/index.css.
Implement full dual-mode support (Manager oversight view + Member personal update view). Provide an intuitive instant role switcher in the header for testing and seamless evaluation.
Manager role capabilities: Create new tasks, assign tasks to any member, edit priority/deadlines, delete tasks, send nudges, view team-wide analytics.
Member role capabilities: View assigned tasks, adjust progress % slider, change status (To Do -> In Progress -> Review -> Done), post progress notes with tags, acknowledge alerts.
In-app Notification Bell: Include unread badge counter, rich popover list categorized by 'Urgent', 'Overdue', and 'Status Updates', with 'Mark all read' and click-to-open task dialog.
Priority Alerts Panel: Place prominently on the Overview dashboard with tabs for Overdue, Due Soon (<24h), and Critical priority tasks.
Kanban View: 4 status columns with visual drag-or-select status changes, interactive progress bars, priority colored indicators, and quick action menus.
Task Detail Dialog: Must feature an interactive progress slider (0-100%), status dropdown, metadata cards, and chronological progress-update timeline with input for adding new notes.
Data Visualizations: Use Recharts for workload per member (stacked/bar charts) and status distribution donuts.
All interactive elements MUST have unique data-testid attributes for testing.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do NOT make generic centered layouts or simplistic flat gradients.
Maintain high density and high contrast for dark mode: solid dark backgrounds (#0B0F17, #111827) with 1px border (#1E293B / #334155).
Never apply universal 'transition: all' which breaks transforms. Use specific properties like 'transition-colors' or 'transition-transform'.
Use Sonner for toasts via toast() import from 'sonner'.
All dialogs, dropdowns, and selects must use customized Shadcn/UI primitives from @/components/ui/.
